explanation: Evidence confirms PALOMA-2 confirmed PALOMA-1's PFS benefit, but none of the evidence states it confirmed the same 'magnitude' of benefit—actual PALOMA-1 PFS values (e.g., ~10.2 vs 20.2 months) differ from PALOMA-2's, so equating magnitudes overstates the evidence.
suggested_rewrite: ...confirming the PFS benefit direction seen earlier in the phase 2 PALOMA-1 trial, though the specific magnitude differed somewhat between the two studies.
